doc.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Mabern and looks forward to the evening concert.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s a good one, and I have learned some nice surprises from you in the last few days.
Well I hope it’s something that can be beneficial.
Yeah. I want to thank you for your time today.
I look forward to your concert tonight.
Thank you Mr. Monk Rowe, well my pleasure.
